steps.label: Guessable beats theft

code:
1. Capture session token BEFORE logout
2. Click logout (UI redirects to login page)
3. Replay the captured token against an
   authenticated API endpoint

-> If the server still honors it: NOT invalidated
caption: Client-side cookie clearing is not server-side session invalidation.

code:
Reset token issued for: user-a@client.com

Tester submits it against: user-b@client.com

If accepted -> token isn't bound to its account
            -> universal account-takeover primitive
caption: A real reset token must be single-use and tied to the account it was issued for.
